tauri-core.name: Tauri Core
tauri-core.description: Tauri entry point. Registers opener/dialog/notification plugins; enables the asset protocol; builds a menu-bar tray and hides the window on close so the scheduler keeps running. Exposes schedule_wake/cancel_wake commands that run pmset (via osascript admin prompt) to wake the Mac from sleep for alarms.

clock-view.name: Clock View
clock-view.description: Clock display surface: analog face or digital/numerical readout with 24-hour and seconds toggles.

analog-clock.name: Analog Clock
analog-clock.description: SVG analog clock face with hour/minute/second hands and tick marks.

alarms-view.name: Alarms View
alarms-view.description: Lists alarms; create, edit, enable/disable, delete, duplicate, and test each one. Header toggle arms macOS wake-from-sleep for alarms.

alarm-editor.name: Alarm Editor
alarm-editor.description: Create/edit an alarm: time, label, repeat days, snooze toggle, trigger (beep/YouTube/file), and an optional solve-to-dismiss puzzle. Provides inline testing for both the sound and the puzzle problems before saving.

ringing-overlay.name: Ringing Overlay
ringing-overlay.description: Full-screen alarm ringing surface; plays the trigger on loop with Dismiss and (when enabled) Snooze. When the alarm has a puzzle, Dismiss opens the solve-to-dismiss gate and the sound pauses until solved or timed out.

trigger-player.name: Trigger Player
trigger-player.description: Renders and loops the active trigger: a WebAudio beep, an embedded looping YouTube video, or a local audio/video element served via the Tauri asset protocol.

puzzle-gate.name: Puzzle Gate
puzzle-gate.description: Solve-to-dismiss overlay: N math problems with a countdown; solving all correctly dismisses the alarm, a wrong answer buzzes and regenerates them, and running out of time resumes the ringing.

stopwatch.name: Stopwatch
stopwatch.description: Stopwatch tab: start/stop/resume/reset with centisecond precision and lap splits. Uses performance.now() so it stays accurate across background throttling.

timer.name: Timer
timer.description: Countdown timer tab: preset or custom mm:ss duration, start/pause/reset; on completion it beeps until dismissed and posts a notification.

pomodoro.name: Pomodoro
pomodoro.description: Pomodoro tab: focus/short-break/long-break cycles with a progress ring, editable durations, auto-start, chime + notification on each phase change, and a completed-session count. Settings persist via #storage.

alarm-scheduler.name: Alarm Scheduler
alarm-scheduler.description: Watches the ticking clock and fires each enabled alarm once per calendar minute, honoring repeat-day filters and deduping missed ticks.

use-now.name: Use Now
use-now.description: Returns the current Date, refreshed on an interval; the single time source shared by the clock display and the alarm scheduler.

storage.name: Storage
storage.description: Loads and saves alarms, clock settings, and pomodoro settings to localStorage; fails safe when storage is unavailable.

beep.name: Beep
beep.description: WebAudio looping beeper plus an audio-unlock helper: resuming the AudioContext on a user gesture so an alarm hours later can still make sound.

youtube.name: Youtube
youtube.description: Parses YouTube video IDs from many URL shapes (watch, youtu.be, embed, shorts, live, bare id) and builds a looping autoplay embed URL.

filepick.name: Filepick
filepick.description: Opens the native Tauri file dialog for an audio/video file and classifies it as audio or video by extension.

native.name: Native
native.description: Native OS integration: request notification permission, post a macOS notification when an alarm fires, and surface (show/unminimize/focus) the window when it is hidden in the tray.

alarm-utils.name: Alarm Utils
alarm-utils.description: Alarm helpers: nextFreeSlot rounds a time up to the next free 15-minute grid slot (skipping times already used), and duplicateAlarm clones an alarm into that slot with a fresh id.

puzzle.name: Puzzle
puzzle.description: Generates simple math problems by difficulty (easy add/subtract, medium multiply/larger sums, hard multiply-and-add) for the solve-to-dismiss gate.

format.name: Format
format.description: Formats a millisecond duration as a clock string (hours only when needed, optional centiseconds) for the stopwatch, timer, and pomodoro.

wake.name: Wake
wake.description: Schedules a macOS wake (via the schedule_wake Tauri command / pmset) ~30s before the earliest upcoming alarm so it fires from full sleep; deduped to avoid repeat admin prompts. Computes each alarm's next occurrence.

alarm-lifecycle.name: Alarm Lifecycle
alarm-lifecycle.description: From creating an alarm through it ringing to being snoozed or dismissed.

steps.name: create
steps.description: User sets time, repeat days, snooze, and a trigger

steps.name: match
steps.description: Scheduler matches current time and fires the alarm

steps.name: ring
steps.description: Full-screen overlay plays the trigger on loop

clock-display.name: Clock Display
clock-display.description: Render the live time as an analog face or a digital/numerical readout.

trigger-preview.name: Trigger Preview
trigger-preview.description: Test an alarm's sound/video before or without waiting for it to fire — from the editor inline, or the play button on a saved alarm card.

alarm-fired.name: Alarm Fired
alarm-fired.description: An enabled alarm's scheduled time was reached; the ringing overlay opens and the trigger begins playing.

alarm-snoozed.name: Alarm Snoozed
alarm-snoozed.description: The user snoozed a ringing alarm; it re-rings after the alarm's snooze interval.

alarm-dismissed.name: Alarm Dismissed
alarm-dismissed.description: The user dismissed a ringing alarm; the overlay closes and any pending snooze is cleared.
